topic: Zoro's chapter 1194 flashback implies Mihawk is a Conqueror's Haki user, seeded since the Baratie fight
title: Mihawk Had Conqueror's Haki The Whole Time (1194)
description: One Piece chapter 1194 may have just revealed that Mihawk has Conqueror's Haki, 28 years after he first appeared. Here is the Zoro flashback clue and the Baratie setup behind it. Do you buy it?
comment: Does Mihawk really have Conqueror's Haki, or was it just a good lesson? Pick a side.

lines.text: Mihawk had Conqueror's Haki the whole time, and Oda hid it for 28 years.

shot.fallback: hawk eyed swordsman with a dark aura

lines.text: Chapter 1194 never says it out loud. But I think the proof is in Zoro's flashback.

shot.fallback: swordsman teaching a green haired swordsman

lines.text: Zoro can't hurt Sommers because he's pouring out Haki without aiming it.

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman facing a giant armored knight

lines.text: Then he remembers Mihawk's lesson: this power comes from your own self.

shot.fallback: swordsman lecturing a student on a gloomy island

lines.text: Here's what everyone skipped. You can't teach a power you've never felt.

shot.fallback: hawk eyed swordsman in dark coat

lines.text: Mihawk says weak people can't even stand against it. That's not advice, that's experience.
Go back to chapter 49, where Mihawk debuts as the strongest swordsman alive.

shot.fallback: hawk eyed swordsman on a small boat

lines.text: Then comes the Baratie duel, where Mihawk nearly kills Zoro.

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman bleeding but standing

lines.text: Fans say it was just advice. But Zoro's breakthrough follows the lesson exactly.

shot.search: Zoro three swords Haki Sommers heart
shot.fallback: swordsman with three swords wrapped in black lightning

lines.text: So the greatest swordsman never needed to say he had it.

shot.fallback: swordsman standing in a ruined castle

lines.text: Oda planted Mihawk's Haki in the first fight, and Zoro just dug it up.

shot.fallback: two swordsmen facing each other in mist

lines.text: Because Mihawk had Conqueror's Haki the whole time...

shot.fallback: hawk eyed swordsman with dark aura
